b: Global Shop Solutions announced the passing of its founder, Dick Alexander, on Nov. 16, 2026.

Alexander founded Global Shop Solutions in 1976 with a simple mission: helping manufacturers run better businesses. What began with punch cards and a rented mainframe computer grew into a global ERP software provider serving manufacturers in more than 22 countries.

Throughout his career, Alexander remained committed to building long-term relationships with customers and employees alike. In the company’s early years, he personally visited customers, gathered manufacturing data and helped implement solutions, establishing a customer-focused culture that continues today.
“We make ERP software by manufacturers for manufacturers. But more than that, we are trusted partners and advisors to our customers,” Alexander often said.
Even in the weeks before his passing, he remained active at the company’s headquarters, mentoring employees and helping guide the business he built.

“His ability to build long-term relationships with our customers resulted in 50 years of stable ownership, steady growth and a legacy of strength that we are immensely proud of,” said Mike Melzer, Vice President of Operations & Service. “He sincerely cared about the development of every employee, providing wisdom, laughter and a listening ear.”
